title: 杠杆ETF单日抛售：450亿美元，谁在买单？
speaker: Cameron Christ

segments.en: Basically, what was the biggest source of the volatility we saw in the markets this week?
segments.zh: 本周市场波动的主要来源是什么？

segments.en: Well, it's interesting because I think you could argue that the largest driver of the price action was leveraged ETFs,
segments.zh: 有趣的是，最大的推动因素可能是杠杆ETF。

segments.en: which are, as the name would suggest, a leveraged way for retail investors to participate in the movements of the financial markets.
segments.zh: 顾名思义，这是散户参与市场波动的一种杠杆方式。

segments.en: What these things do is, as you expect, they amplify the volatility and the nature of the product is such that when the market goes up, they have to buy more, simply to maintain their target exposure.
segments.zh: 这类产品会放大波动，市场上涨时需买入更多以维持目标敞口。

segments.en: When the market goes down, they have to sell more to maintain their target exposure.
segments.zh: 市场下跌时则需卖出更多。

segments.en: When the price action starts to roll over, as we saw this week, these things generate very, very substantial flows.
segments.zh: 当价格走势逆转时，就像本周，这些产品会产生非常巨大的资金流。

segments.en: I think on Wednesday, the estimate is that they contributed something like $45 billion of selling into the close.
segments.zh: 周三估计贡献了约450亿美元的卖出。

segments.en: This is a new development, and so far as the assets under management of these things has exploded, as the AI trade has driven prices up,
segments.zh: 这是新情况，随着AI行情推高价格，这类产品的管理规模已激增。

segments.en: and it's reminiscent of what we saw in early 2018, when volatility-based exchange-traded notes blew up the market temporarily in early February.
segments.zh: 这让人想起2018年初，波动率相关产品在2月一度引发市场动荡。
